law_name: Copyright Act, 1998 (Chapter 323), consolidated through Act No. 2 of 2004 (LRO 1/2010)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (individual works: 70 years from end of calendar year of author's death; anonymous works publication + 70 years)
moral_rights: Right to be identified as author and right to object to derogatory treatment of a visual artwork (Part III; articles not seen)
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing for research and private study, criticism, review and reporting (Part VI; list non-exclusive per commentary) (unconfirmed)
registration_required: No (Part V provides voluntary registration; registration is not a prerequisite to infringement actions, per section headings)
enforcement_body: Bahamas Copyright Office (named by a law-firm article; administering department not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
notes: WCT accession deposited 11 July 2026 and in force 11 October 2026 (WIPO notification). Berne member since 10 July 1973 per Commons. WPPT and TRIPS not confirmed, so not listed.
